text:
Predicates:  
Streaming(x) ::: x is a streaming service  
Hardcover(x) ::: x is a hardcover book  
PrintedText(x) ::: x is printed text  
Digital(x) ::: x is digital  
Analog(x) ::: x is analog  
Year1984 ::: the year 1984  

Premises:  
¬∃x (Digital(x) ∧ Analog(x)) ::: No digital media are analog  
∀x (PrintedText(x) → Analog(x)) ::: Every printed text is analog  
∀x (Streaming(x) → Digital(x)) ::: All streaming services are digital  
∀x (Hardcover(x) → PrintedText(x)) ::: If an object is a hardcover book then it is printed text  
∀x (Year1984(x) → Streaming(x) → Hardcover(x)) ::: If 1984 is a streaming service, then 1984 is a hardcover book  

Conclusion:  
Streaming(1984) ::: 1984 is a streaming service
